Interface UserService

All Known Implementing Classes:
UserServiceImpl
public interface UserService
============================================================================== User Service (Business Logic Interface) ============================================================================== Defines the contract for user account management, lookup, and administrative operations.

Controllers interact exclusively through this interface, keeping the presentation layer decoupled from the persistence and hashing logic.
